templates.title: OmniRoute
templates.name: omniroute
templates.description: OmniRoute is a self-hosted LLM router. The dashboard and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on one port send requests to the provider accounts you connect, with Redis for rate limiting.

env.name: DATA_DIR
env.label: DATA_DIR
env.description: SQLite data directory. Must match the data volume.

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.label: REDIS_URL
env.description: Redis on the compose network. Not published to the host.

env.name: REQUIRE_API_KEY
env.label: REQUIRE_API_KEY
env.description: Require a dashboard login and an API key. Required because the ports are published on all interfaces.

env.name: INITIAL_PASSWORD
env.label: INITIAL_PASSWORD
env.description: Dashboard password created on first boot.

env.name: OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB
env.label: OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB
env.description: V8 heap ceiling from the self-host env example.
